messages:
marta: Heads-up — canary (canary-us-east) p95 decode latency jumped ~2.3x after merge `abc123` :eyes:
ken: link to perf dash: https://perf.redwood/team/decodes?canary=1 — spike starts right after the merge
priya: started a local bisect on the merged range, I think the fused quant decode optimization landed in that PR
alex: repro logs from my local run (A100, seq=32):
```
kernel launch: fused_quant_decode_v2  duration=2.1ms
gpu stall: wait_for_kv  duration=1.7ms
attention_kernel: fallback_shared_mem duration=1.9ms  (high occupancy wait)
overall token p95 +230%
```
natalie: KV cache miss rate for the traces that spiked is +18%, seems correlated w/ small-batch workloads hitting cold prefixes
marta: seeing batcher queue depth jump and many small batches (1-4 seqs). batching heuristic seems to be getting starved / backpressured
ken: I can reliably reproduce with a synthetic workload that sends many short requests (seq 16/32). If I disable `fused_quant_decode` I don't see the tail stalls — looks like kernel selection + quant path interacts badly with our batching logic
priya: CI is already red on perf suite for decode-p95 and decode-throughput after the merge
ci-bot: [perf-test] decode-p95: +121% (FAIL), decode-throughput: -34% (FAIL) — see run https://ci.redwood/runs/8492
alex: preliminary root cause guess: `fused_quant_decode_v2` changes kernel selection heuristics for attention. When quantized and kv_hit_rate < ~80%, selector prefers fallback_shared_mem which has poor small-batch latency on Turing/GA100 due to low SM occupancy + additional synchronizations. That creates backpressure into the batcher and causes many small batches to queue up
marta: mitigation idea: hotpatch kernel_selector to prefer `stable_attention_v1` for short seq (<=64) OR when measured kv_hit_rate < 85% to avoid the fallback path
ken: I can prepare a minimal hotfix and push a canary flag within the hour. Also will add a metric that surfaces kernel choice and per-kernel tail latency to the console
sre: pausing canary rollout now and capturing host/gpu traces. Please coordinate any immediate pushes with me
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by sre — reason: p95 latency regression observed
priya: +1 on temporary revert if hotfix will take too long. We should revert `abc123` until we have a safe kernel fallback and add a small-batch perf test to the gate
natalie: will add a regression test for seq<=64 quantized decode and a KV-hit simulation to the perf harness (low overhead, can run in CI)
marta: plan: 1) ken pushes hotfix flag to prefer stable kernel for short seq, 2) canary re-run, 3) if still bad revert `abc123`, 4) add regression tests & solidify selector heuristics. Assigning follow-ups in GH after we stabilize. :thumbsup:
ken: working on the hotfix branch now, will tag the canary build once ready
alex: thanks — when you push the canary, please include a small synthetic load (seq 16/32) in the smoke run so we catch tail regressions early
priya: noted. I'll keep the bisect running and post the offending commit when I have a narrowed range
marta: thanks everyone, keep updates here. If anyone finds alternate root causes (memory thrash, allocator contention) paste logs.
